title: Beige hotel
content: Not the fancy one everyone talks about. The normal hotel, beige walls and carpets. Doors & windows either aren't a thing here or they just never close? People wandering in and out of rooms and everywhere. There is no semblance of privacy but it doesn't seem to be a big deal. I felt like people rested there when they needed to and then kept wandering after that. Does this hotel sound familiar to anyone?
